verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, and bulk operations across many items is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents any batch or multi-item operation capability. The agent's git workflow actions (gh-5) and the full-permissions toggle (gh-6) are adjacent features, not bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
